title: Sunset Rum Punch
description: Full of fresh citrus juice, a touch of almond syrup, and plenty of good rum, a mug of this punch is great for watching sunsets with friends.
ingredients: 1.5 fluid ounces spiced rum (such as Kraken®)
1 fluid ounce freshly squeezed lime juice
1 fluid ounce freshly squeezed orange juice
1 fluid ounce freshly squeezed grapefruit juice
0.75 fluid ounce white rum (such as Captain Morgan™)
0.75 fluid ounce dark rum (such as Myers's®)
0.75 fluid ounce almond orgeat syrup (such as Torani®)

steps.text: Combine crushed ice, spiced rum, lime juice, orange juice, grapefruit juice, white rum, dark rum, hibiscus syrup, and almond syrup in a cocktail shaker. Cover and shake until the outside of the shaker has frosted.
Fill a tiki mug with crushed ice. Strain cocktail over ice. Garnish with orange slice and maraschino cherry.

video.description: All the colors of the sunset combine in this cocktail full of 3 fresh juices, 3 rums and 2 aromatic sweet syrups. Bring together your favorite spiced, white and dark rums, then add fresh grapefruit, orange and lime juices. Finally, add sweet orgeat almond syrup and tangy-floral hibiscus syrup. All the flavors come together in an altogether delicious, easy-to-drink punch. Make sure to have plenty of ingredients on hand for easy sharing with great friends.
